```{r}
# we install the development files in order to avoid some nasty bug when converting VCF to GDS
#library("devtools")
#install_github("zhengxwen/gdsfmt")
#install_github("zhengxwen/SNPRelate")
rm(list=ls())
library(SNPRelate)
library(parallel)
library(xtable)
library(naturalsort)
library(pheatmap)
library(readxl)

#library(VariantAnnotation)

GDS_FILE = "ESGIv2_samples_noSNP.gds"

vcf.fn = "./ESGIv2_calls_merged_noSNP_only.vcf.gz"

# vcf = readVcf(vcf.fn)
# ref = as.character(rowRanges(vcf)$REF)
# alt = unstrsplit(CharacterList(rowRanges(vcf)$ALT), sep=",")
# inc = (nchar(alt)==1 & nchar(ref)==1)

snpgdsVCF2GDS(vcf.fn, GDS_FILE, method="biallelic.only")

gds_summary = snpgdsSummary(GDS_FILE)
samples = gds_summary$sample.id

genofile <- snpgdsOpen(GDS_FILE)
```

```{r}
ed = read_excel("../../../../metadata/DNA/SampleDescription.xls", sheet = 1)

ed$ShortID = paste(ed$SampleName, ed$CloneID, sep="_")
sample_codes = as.data.frame(ed)
# rownames(sample_codes) = as.character(sample_codes$ID)
rownames(sample_codes) = as.character(sample_codes$SampleID)
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
mm = snpgdsGetGeno(genofile)
snplist <- snpgdsSNPList(genofile)
rownames(mm) = samples
colnames(mm) = paste(snplist$chromosome, snplist$position, sep="_")
```


We keep all variants - no pruning. 

```{r, message=FALSE}
snpset <- snpgdsLDpruning(genofile, ld.threshold=1)
snpset.id <- unlist(snpset)
```

# Primary Component Analyis on genotypes of all samples
```{r}
sample.id <- read.gdsn(index.gdsn(genofile, "sample.id"))

pca <- snpgdsPCA(genofile, snp.id=snpset.id, num.thread=8, verbose=F)

tab <- data.frame(sample.id = pca$sample.id, 
                  EV1 = pca$eigenvect[,1], # the first eigenvector
                  EV2 = pca$eigenvect[,2], # the second eigenvector
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

plot(tab$EV2, tab$EV1, col="black",xlab="eigenvector 2", ylab="eigenvector 1", pch=20)

```



# Multi-Dimensional-Scaling on Identity-by-state distances of all samples

```{r}
ibs <- snpgdsIBS(genofile, num.thread=8, verbose=F)
loc <- cmdscale(1 - ibs$ibs, k = 2)
x <- loc[, 1]; y <- loc[, 2]
```

```{r}
plot(x, y, col="black", xlab = "", ylab = "", main = "Multidimensional Scaling Analysis (IBS Distance)",pch=20)
#legend("bottomleft", legend=levels(race), text.col=1:nlevels(race))
```


# Proportion of IBS2 between genotypes of all samples

IBS2 is the state of identic genotypes when comparing two samples at the same site (i.e. 2 shared alleles; IBS1 corresponds to 1 shared allele and IBS0 to no shared alleles). We compute the proportion of IBS2 states across all selected SNP positions in order to define similarities between samples.

## Distribution of IBS2 proportion values


```{r}
# Proportion of identical genotypes between sammples
ibsNum = snpgdsIBSNum(genofile, snp.id=snpset.id, num.thread=8, verbose=F)
```

```{r, fig.cap="Proportion of IBS2 between genotypes of all samples"}
i = ibsNum$ibs2/(ibsNum$ibs2 + ibsNum$ibs1 + ibsNum$ibs0)
rownames(i) = samples
colnames(i) = samples
i_ut = i
i_ut[upper.tri(i_ut, diag=T)] = NA
xx = hist(i_ut,200, plot=F)
ff = xx$counts
valid_ticks = seq(1,length(xx$breaks),10)
names(ff) = xx$mids
names(ff)[(1:length(ff))[-valid_ticks]] <- NA
barplot(log10(ff+1),las=2, xlab="Proportion IBS2", ylab="log10(frequency)")
title("Distribution of IBS2 proportions across all samples")
```

Note that for pretty much all distances between sample pairs the IBS2 proportion (i.e. proportion of sites with identic genotype among all compared sites) is lower than 0.85. Only a few dozen pairs show IBS2 proportions > 0.9, which are shown below.

# Samples with IBS2 proportions > 0.9

```{r}
high_concordance_samples = as.data.frame(which(i_ut>0.8 & i_ut<1,arr.ind=T))
high_concordance_samples$sample_1 <- rownames(i_ut)[high_concordance_samples$row]
high_concordance_samples$sample_2 <- colnames(i_ut)[high_concordance_samples$col]
high_concordance_samples$ibs2_prop = apply(as.matrix(high_concordance_samples[,1:2]), 1, function(x) {i_ut[x[1],x[2]]})
high_concordance_samples = high_concordance_samples[order(high_concordance_samples$sample_1, high_concordance_samples$sample_2),3:5]
rownames(high_concordance_samples) = NULL
```

```{r, results='asis'}
xt = xtable(high_concordance_samples, digits=3)
print.xtable(xt,type="html")
```

```{r}
target_ibs2 = i
target_ibs2_ut = target_ibs2
target_ibs2_ut[upper.tri(target_ibs2_ut)] <- NA

```

# Proportion of IBS2 for all samples

```{r, results='asis'}
ot = xtable(round(target_ibs2_ut,3), digits=3)
print.xtable(ot,type="html")
```

### Heatmap of similiarities (IBS2 proportion) between samples
```{r}
pheatmap(target_ibs2,scale="none")
```

### Dendrogram

```{r}
set.seed(100)
ibs.hc <- snpgdsHCluster(ibs)
rv <- snpgdsCutTree(ibs.hc)
plot(rv$dendrogram, leaflab="perpendicular", main="All samples")
```

```{r}
snpgdsClose(genofile)
```
